global_prompt: A photorealistic scene in a vast field of tall green grass at sunset, filmed as a continuous low-angle handheld tracking shot.
local_prompts: A rugged caveman wearing animal furs walks through tall green grass at sunset while the camera tracks alongside him.
The camera rapidly pans downward past the caveman's hairy legs until motion-blurred green grass completely fills the frame.
The camera rapidly pans upward from the grass, revealing a Spartan soldier wearing bronze greaves, a red tunic, and carrying a large round shield.
The camera rapidly pans downward past the Spartan's shield and armored legs until motion-blurred green grass completely fills the frame.
The camera rapidly pans upward from the grass, revealing a medieval knight in shining plate armor riding a horse.
